svg.title: Libbet and the Magic Floor captured on the DE10-Lite: the title, a valid roll and the wrong move that busts the combo, every frame read back from the board over UART
svg.text: Libbet and the Magic Floor v0.08 · Damian Yerrick, Zlib licence · frames captured on the DE10-Lite over UART
Start (128): the floor loads with the LCD off
Left (2): faces left, no valid neighbour
Up (4): a valid roll, HUD reads 1 Combo 25% 1/04
Right (1): off the floor, the wrong move busts the combo
Down (8): the reverse of a one-shade roll is invalid
Idle on the top-right cell, combo back to 0
Frames captured on the board running the pinned third-party image; wiki/showcase/README.md records the session.
